attributification.config.desc: Unifies similar attributes from different mods
Logging level: NONE, ERRORS, WARNINGS, ALL
attributification.config.mappings.desc: List of attribute mappings that unify source attributes to target attributes
attributification.config.staticMapping.s: The attribute that will be aliased
attributification.config.mapping.sourceA: The attribute that will be redirected (e.g., 'spell_power:fire')
attributification.config.mapping.targetA: The attribute to redirect to. Use comma for fallback (e.g., 'irons_spellbooks:fire_spell_power')
attributification.config.mapping.equival: Multiplier for virtual display: source = target × equivalence
attributification.config.mapping.convers: Divisor for modifier conversion: target_value = source_value / conversionEquivalence (0 = use equivalence)
attributification.config.mapping.unidire: If true, source shows target value directly without multiplication
attributification.config.mapping.onlyVis: If true, only renames the attribute without converting modifier values
attributification.config.mapping.fullRep: If true, source attribute is frozen and only target attribute works (prevents duplication)
attributification.config.mapping.subtrac: Value to subtract from target before applying equivalence (for attributes with different base values)
attributification.config.mapping.operati: How to convert modifier operations: DEFAULT (no change), ADDITION_TO_MULTIPLY_BASE, or ADDITION_TO_MULTIPLY_TOTAL
